questions.question: A letter writer said he and the others with him were eyewitnesses of Jesus's majesty. True or false?
On the holy mountain, what did the voice from the Majestic Glory say about Jesus?

answers.text: This is My beloved Son in whom I am well pleased
This is My messenger who will prepare the way
This is the Lamb who will take away all sin

questions.question: A letter writer told believers that paying attention to the word of the prophets is like paying attention to what?

answers.text: A lamp shining in a dark place
A trumpet sounding over a city
A well of water in a desert

questions.question: A letter writer told believers that no prophecy of Scripture comes from what?
